name: Peritus
tagline: Structured coaching that turns ranked grind into measurable rank.
positioning: Peritus pairs competitive players with vetted coaches and a review system built around VOD timestamps, drills, and honest progress tracking.

hero.sub: Peritus connects serious players with vetted coaches who review your VODs frame by frame, assign targeted drills, and hold you accountable to the rank you're actually chasing.

features.title: Timestamped VOD reviews
features.description: Coaches annotate your matches at the exact frame a decision went wrong, then attach the fix — no vague 'play better' notes, just specific mistakes and corrections.

features.title: Drill assignments
features.description: Every session ends with concrete homework: aim routines, wave-management reps, or map calls to rehearse before your next scheduled review.

features.title: Progress that's measurable
features.description: Track win rate, KDA trends, and rank movement against the goals you set, so you can see whether the coaching is actually working.

features.title: Vetted coach roster
features.description: Every coach passes a screening on peak rank, teaching samples, and player feedback before they ever take a paid session on Peritus.

features.title: Sessions that fit your schedule
features.description: Book live reviews or async VOD breakdowns around your ranked hours, with reminders so no session slips through.

features.title: Multi-title support
features.description: One account, one coaching history across League, Valorant, CS2, and Dota 2 — switch titles without starting your record from zero.
